CREATURE/DRAGONSPAWN2_MODULAR/DRAGONSPAW.note: I-392: retail dragonspawn2 with every group-1 armour set split into parts. Donor files are retail creature/dragonspawn2 (model FDID 4183015, build 12.1.0.69933) as converted by cli/lib/retail.py (WXL downport + m2_skin_rebuild, logs/retail_cache/out/creature/dragonspawn2), renamed to dragonspawn2_modular: the client caches models by stem, and the picker offers <parent>_modular wherever <parent> (creature/dragonspawn2/dragonspawn2.m2) is offered (lib/repoint_complete.modular_variants). The base is LOD1 (55,824 indices): retail skin00 (71,283 indices) overflows WotLK's u16 submesh starts and loses horns 304-306 and ears/jaw 401-405. Groups: 1 chest/collar (key bones 53 spine, 4 SpineLow, 26 Root), 2 waist, 3 horns/crest, 4 ears/jaw (2-4 unchanged), 5 helmet (6 Head, 49), 6 left shoulder (2 ShoulderL, 0 ArmL), 7 right shoulder (3 ShoulderR, 1 ArmR), 8 bracers/gauntlets/boots (61 62 64 65 forearms, 78 79 84 85 feet). Variant = source set (102-107), so a nibble naming a set with no such piece hides the group. Only pure pad islands stay in the shoulder parts: welded pieces spanning chest and shoulder bones (the 102/103 sash, the 106/107 chest plate rim and the straps over the shoulders) are "mixed" islands sent whole to the chest. Set 105: the hood is cut per triangle with its shoulder triangles sent to the robe (the helmet 505 still comes out) and the circlets dropped (604/704 offer the same pieces), so 105 = robe + helmet. 603 (retail's big pauldron) stays left-only (the user's call). Boss pieces (skin.import, variant 8): 508 helm crest, 608 / 708 boss pads, each armour + glow; fixed boss textures, so they keep the boss colours on every skin.

I-392: retail dragonspawn2.m2 (1 view, so the client loads only DRAGONSPAWN2_MODULAR00.SKIN) plus retail dragonspawn2boss's pads and helm crest (donors/, FDID of creature/dragonspawn2boss/dragonspawn2boss.m2, converted by lib/retail.convert): its submesh 2 (armour, boss armour texture + reflect) and 3 (additive glow on UV2, imported static: our model has no UV animation) written over unused lower-LOD vertices from 16509 (sliced numbering), bones remapped onto this rig (same pivots; the boss's 4 pad flap bones ride their parents). Textures 3 = boss armour as replaceable type 13 (the display's 3rd skin slot: dragonspawn2boss_armor_<colour>, black = the retail gold), 4 = glow (fixed); texture lookup 4-5 = (boss armour, reflect), 6-7 = (glow, glow); material 4 = (21, 4) additive; texture unit lookup 2-3 = (0, 1). base_sha256 pins the donor. Vertex array sliced to 20030..39560 (LOD1's run + the boss pieces; m2.vertices.slice): the picker merges weapon/shield meshes into the model as extra vertices, which the u16 skin lookup cannot reach past 65,535 on the full 86k array.

CREATURE/DESERTLASHERORCHID_MODULAR/DESE.note: I-396: the HD desert lasher orchid (patch-hd-creatures-mounts creature/desertlasherorchid, view 00) split by texture region so each part samples its own creature skin: stem/roots/vine arms on skin 1 (texture_variation_1), petals/leaves on skin 2, beak/jaw/teeth on skin 3. The donor is one submesh (geoset 0) whose 143 UV islands sit in separate texture areas; boxes test each island's UV centroid (checked against a 3D render: 0 misassigned islands). combo_add points each part's two batches (skin+oldglass3 env, skin alpha layer) at its pair in the texture lookup set by the .M2 recipe. skin.overlay adds the petal pattern group on the flower part (submesh 2): 101 plain (empty), 102 spots, 103 stripes; a display names one in creature_geoset_data (0x1/0x2/0x3).

I-396: patch-hd-creatures-mounts creature/desertlasherorchid/desertlasherorchid.m2 renamed (the client caches models by stem). Its 19 skins are copied next to it as lasher_<colour> / orchid_<colour> (LasherSkin = lasher_natural) so the picker's colour swap works, and oldglass3.blp moves into this folder. Adds creature skin 2/3 textures (types 12/13) and a texture lookup of one (skin N, glass) pair per split part; declares 1 skin profile (only 00 ships). Petal pattern layer: lasher_spots / lasher_stripes (type 0, greyscale, 128 = no change) on a Mod2x material (unlit, two-sided, no depth write) for the skin.overlay geosets.
